bugs.bug: xml_escape removes only color sequences matching `ESC[ digits;+ m`, so other ANSI escape sequences (cursor movement, erase) stay in the JUnit XML and the + quantifier also requires at least one digit
bugs.example: bats-format-junit: REGEX=ESC\[[0-9;]+m matches only SGR colour codes ending in m, so sequences such as ESC[2K or ESC[1A are left in the output, producing invalid XML characters
